items.text: Early mobilisation and safe-handling steps follow the unit's approved procedure, the physiotherapy plan and manual-handling policy. No source for safety criteria or steps has been read.

checklist.text: Confirm the mobilisation plan and safety criteria set by your unit and physiotherapist.
Stop and call for help if the patient becomes unstable.
Record activity and tolerance per unit standard.
